mintAuthority.summary: BUCK was issued by Buck Labs as an RWA-backed savings coin; access-gated stewards minted and refunded BUCK through the issuer-controlled LiquidityWindow contract, pricing against an off-chain STRC collateral attestation with USDC settling into the LiquidityReserve. No permissionless or user-collateralized mint route existed.

controls.label: Buck Labs LiquidityWindow mint/refund desk
controls.evidence: Per the buck-v1 contract docs, access-gated stewards mint/refund BUCK through the LiquidityWindow against a collateral-aware peg with per-account caps and oracle freshness; primary-market access is AML-gated and operator-controlled.

controls.label: PolicyManager / CollateralAttestation (off-chain STRC valuation)
controls.evidence: CollateralAttestation is the on-chain copy of off-chain STRC valuation; PolicyManager gates fees, spreads and mint/refund allowances via Green/Yellow/Red/Emergency bands, so issuer-controlled off-chain attestation governs whether mints are permitted.

controls.label: BUCK token contract owner EOA (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294984, owner() on 0xdb13997f4d83ef343845d0baeb27d1173df8c224 returned 0x376269214bb78b3d4f31d17600499b439c1acb4b; eth_getCode on that address returned 2 bytes (EOA confirmed). The BUCK token is a UUPS upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x223de9a74547edee200772248ee4b703d8a774a6; no EIP-1967 proxy admin slot set). The EOA owner controls upgrade and administrative rights, but mint authority is exercised through the LiquidityWindow backend.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294984: owner() on BUCK token (0xdb13997f...) = EOA 0x376269214bb78b3d4f31d17600499b439c1acb4b (eth_getCode confirms no bytecode). EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x223de9a74547edee200772248ee4b703d8a774a6 (contract); EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS proxy pattern). The LiquidityWindow is a separate contract not independently enumerated here. Project is wound down as of April 2026.
unresolvedQuestions: LiquidityWindow contract address not independently confirmed on-chain; the minting mechanism runs through it but its address was not resolved from the token contract. Project wound down April 2026 — further verification has limited value.
